reply: To recommend a spectroscopy method, we first need to identify the contaminant or the affected quality variable in your liquid process. Without this information, selecting a method is premature. Initial lab trials using multiple spectroscopy methods can help identify key spectral features and guide method selection. Consider starting with a multi-method lab trial to explore potential contaminants and affected variables.
